About the Role

Job Title: Data Scientist

Contract Type: Contract in Brazil

Office model - Remote

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist focused on evaluating LLM-based products. The role is all about making sure AI outputs are high-quality, accurate, safe, and useful, using a mix of human evaluation and LLM-based evaluation approaches (LLM-as-a-Judge and LLM-as-a-Jury). You’ll work closely with SMEs, product, and engineering teams to build and scale evaluation frameworks that help improve AI products.

What You’ll Do:

  • Review and evaluate LLM outputs for quality, accuracy, safety, and relevance.
  • Work with SMEs on manual and human-in-the-loop evaluations.
  • Use LLMs to evaluate other LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge / LLM-as-a-Jury)
  • Define simple evaluation criteria and scoring guidelines.
  • Analyze results and share clear feedback with product and engineering teams.
  • Help improve evaluation processes and best practices over time.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 6-7 years of experience in Data Science, ML, or AI roles.
  • Strong experience with LLMs and Generative AI.
  • AWS: Core AWS - Lambda, EC2, S3, SQS, SNS, etc.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating LLM outputs (manual or automated).
  • Solid Python skills for analysis and automation.
  • Experience with LLMs like ChatGPT, Claude, Mistral, or similar.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with AI evaluation metrics or quality frameworks.
  • Familiarity with LLMOps or AI monitoring.
  • Interest in AI safety, reliability, and responsible AI processes.

title: Diretor(a) de Manufatura
description:
Fundada em 1899, a Sonoco é um fabricante líder de embalagens de consumo, industriais, cuidados de saúde e de proteção.

A Sonoco está empenhada em criar produtos, serviços e programas sustentáveis para os nossos clientes, funcionários e comunidades. A Sonoco foi listada como uma das empresas mais admiradas do mundo pela Fortune em 2021, além de ter sido incluída nas 100 empresas mais sustentáveis da Barron pelo terceiro ano consecutivo.

Saiba mais em Sonoco.com

Subordinados indiretos : 700

Plantas: 8

Formação/Requisitos :

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão Industrial ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência em posições executivas de Manufatura, com gestão integral de plantas industriais;
  • Visão estratégica, forte perfil de liderança e foco em resultados;
  • Inglês e Espanhol fluentes.

Principais Responsabilidades :

  • Liderar as operações industriais, incluindo manufatura, manutenção, logística, engenharia, qualidade e melhoria contínua;
  • Promover e fortalecer a cultura da empresa no que tange a Segurança, Experiência do Cliente, Qualidade e Desenvolvimento de Pessoas;
  • Definir e acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs) para ganhos de eficiência, produtividade, lead time, custos e nível de serviço;
  • Desenvolver e executar o planejamento estratégico dos negócios sob sua responsabilidade, cumprindo premissas orçamentárias através da gestão do budget e P&L;
  • Manter foco no desenvolvimento de talentos visando planos de sucessão consistentes e estruturados para crescimento e sustentação da organização garantindo treinamentos, recursos e ferramentas necessárias;

title: Senior Java Developer
description:

We are more than 500 consultants with offices in Lisbon, Porto and Madrid.

Our practice results in the creation of value for our customers, either by delivering qualified and value-added services, or through highly qualified and motivated professionals, as well as technology solutions that allow us to operate and transform the business of our customers.

We are looking for a Senior Java Developer for a remote project in Brazil.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in Java development and proficiency in the latest editions of Java, including expertise in Spring Boot.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS, Microservices architecture, and design patterns.
  • Strong knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience in frontend technologies like React.js or Angular is a strong plus.
  • Experience in NodeJs and PostgreSQL database is a plus.
  • Solid grasp of security best practices related to APIs and data privacy.
  • Proficiency in Agile/Scrum methodologies and a commitment to driving Agile practices within the team.
  • Comfortable with DevOps practices involving configuration management, CI/CD pipelines, Gitflow, IaC, deployment patterns among others.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
  • Proficiency in English is a must.

Role and Key Accountabilities:

  • Translate application storyboards and use cases into functional applications.
  • Design, build and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code.
  • Ensure the best possible performance, quality and responsiveness of the applications.
  • Collaborate closely with the Product Owner to ensure alignment with business requirements and meet delivery timelines.
  • Prioritize and facilitate the early resolution of client issues, ensuring adherence to agreed Service Level Agreements (SLA).
  • Conduct code reviews, contribute to critical feature designs, and ensure the overall quality of the team's deliverables.
  • Flag technical debt and areas of improvements, making sure they are properly documented and taken into account when defining priorities.
  • Implement a robust documentation system for knowledge base, onboarding, knowledge transfer, and communication in software development activities.
  • Identify bottlenecks and bugs and devise solutions to these problems.
  • Follow Agile Scrum development process for application development.

If you’re interested in this job please send your CV in English to with reference “DA/SJD” .

title: Sales Account Manager
description:
Sales Account Manager

Location: Brazil (Remote)

About the role:

As an Sales Account Manager , you will play a pivotal role in achieving sales targets and driving the growth of BSI America’s product and service offerings related to ISO standards and certifications. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who thrives in a target-driven environment and enjoys developing long-term relationships with clients.

In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

  • Drive Sales Growth : As a hunter in the sales field, develop and nurture relationships with existing clients while identifying and securing new business opportunities through prospecting and cold calling.
  • Consultative Selling : Engage with key decision-makers in small to midsize organizations to present and position BSI products and services, helping them meet ISO standards.
  • Pipeline Development : Identify and qualify new business leads, building a continuous sales pipeline to support long-term success.
  • Client Relationship Management : Foster strong relationships with clients, ensuring continuous business growth and repeat engagements.
  • Market Trend Identification : Stay ahead of industry trends, strategizing to capture new revenue generation opportunities.
  • Accurate Reporting : Provide timely and accurate sales reports, supporting business forecasting and strategy development.
  • Travel for Success : Travel to visit clients on a quarterly basis, building personal connections and furthering business opportunities.

To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • Sales Experience : At least four years of experience in sales.
  • Industry Knowledge : Familiarity with the certification industry and/or ISO standards is a plus, though not essential.
  • Exceptional Communication Skills : Strong ability to negotiate, influence, and build relationships with both internal teams and external clients.
  • Collaboration Mindset : Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Tech-Savvy : Experience with CRM tools like SAP and Salesforce is an advantage.
  • Valid Driver's License : Travel to client sites is required on a quarterly basis.

What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of; 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, maternal leave, paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.

Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.

Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial, and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance and regulatory services we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.

D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

title: Quality Assurance Director (Senador Canedo / GO)
description:
Coty is one of the world's largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skincare, and body care brands. They celebrate and foster a culture of kindness and pride themselves on offering equal opportunities. Coty believes that beauty is found in diversity and is committed to creating an environment where every talent shines, valuing the unique contributions each individual brings to the team. As part of their commitment to inclusion, all profiles are welcome at Coty.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Brazil Quality Director is responsible for the quality of all Coty production in Brazil and serves as a key senior leader accountable for end-to-end quality across the product lifecycle, from design to consumer.

The role oversees quality standards, GMP compliance for all markets served, incident management, new product introductions, vendor quality, non-conforming products, and the delivery of right-first-time results, ensuring product quality from manufacturing through delivery to customers and consumers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Analize current end to end process from development to production against quality standards;
  • Direct Leadership Responsibility for Senador Manufacturing Quality Leader and Goiania DC quality;
  • Responsibility for Product Disposition within Brazil;
  • Responsible for Brazil Quality KPI’s;
  • Define and lead the Quality strategy for Brazil;
  • Responsible for Compliance of the Brazilian sites / TPMs and its product and the markets that it produces for;
  • Responsible for the Quality Capability development of the Site QA Leader and QA Teams in the various technical areas eg Raw Materials, Packaging, Bulk, Finished Goods and all aspects of Quality Control and including Quality Assurance;
  • Responsibility to ensure compliance of the sites to the relevant GMP Standards (RDC 48/2013, ISO 22716:2007);
  • Follow up and ensure resulting actions from the various QA processes are driven to a conclusion and that those conclusions are institutionalized;
  • End to End Quality Ownership for Brazilian products;
  • Key KPI’s – Compliance, Quality Alerts and Incidents, Right First Time, Defects, Consumer and Customer Complaints, Initiative Right First Time and Cost of Quality;
  • Responsible for the Industrialization of new products;
  • Strong Partnership with other functions for delivery of key results including R&D, Marketing, Procurement, etc.

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must have a degree in Chemistry, Chemical engineering, Biology, Medicine Pharmacy, Food, Public Health or Legal science or equivalen;
  • Must know Brazilian Cosmetic Regulations RDC 48/2013;
  • Must have a minimum of 10 years of Cosmetic Production or Quality Experience;
  • Operational experience within Supply Chain Manufacturing Sites;
  • Must have a background as a Quality Manager of a Production Facility;
  • Excellent communicator, being able to translate complex problems into clear solutions with strong Corrective and Preventative Actions and communicate this internally and externally as required;
  • Strong influencing skills to be the “voice” of the Consumer to the business;
  • Attention to the details, but with the ability to delegate and supervise;
  • Strong systemic approach to work to ensure that issues are fixed for good and willingness to escalate, confront and correct even the most Senior of leadership;
  • Fluency in English and Spanish required.

SOFT SKILLS

  • Calm under pressure;
  • Able to be decisive and a fearless decision maker;
  • Drives activity in others with energy, likes to get things done;
  • Data driven mindset;
  • Able to identify, rate and minimize risks;
  • Strong communication skills across various stakeholders.

Na sua rotina, você irá:

  • Realização de estudos e preparação de pareceres sobre questões envolvendo a legislação tributária.

Na área de Tax & Legal , o time atua 3(três) vezes por semana em formato presencial, sejam nas dependências físicas dos escritórios da Deloitte ou de nossos clientes.

Na Deloitte, buscamos pessoas que queiram gerar impactos positivos todos os dias. Impulsionamos talentos para que possam se desenvolver em um ambiente colaborativo, com times diversos e que tragam energia, empoderamento, interação e conexões. O nosso crescimento é exponencial porque os talentos que recrutamos possuem os nossos valores em suas essências.

Liderar o caminho, fomentar a inclusão, colaborar para mensurar impactos, servir com integridade e cuidar uns dos outros são pontos essenciais e inegociáveis para fortalecer ainda mais o nosso propósito.

Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto.

O que você precisa para se candidatar à vaga?

  • Experiência com revisões, recuperações de créditos e projetos relacionados à reforma tributária de impostos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL);
  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou Direito;
  • Inglês será considerado um diferencial;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em um dos escritórios da Deloitte Brasil.

O que estará disponível para você?

Desenvolvimento profissional

É claro que cuidaríamos do seu desenvolvimento aqui na Deloitte! Queremos que você alcance seus objetivos profissionais e pessoais e, por isso, contamos com Universidade Corporativa, acesso a plataformas online de aprendizado, plataforma de idiomas com mais de 7.500 conteúdos e cerca de 60 cursos divididos por nível, área de atuação, habilidades profissionais e interesses, e até uma plataforma que reúne diversas instituições de ensino, fornecendo descontos exclusivos para profissionais Deloitte e seus dependentes.

Além disso, oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado, com mentoria de profissionais da Deloitte por meio de um(a) coach, que poderá ouvir seus desafios e apoiar para que consiga evoluir tanto com habilidades técnicas, quanto com habilidades comportamentais com base na própria experiência. É ótimo ter uma pessoa mentora, não é mesmo?

Cuidados com o seu bem-estar

Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:

  • Serviço de telemedicina para que você consiga fazer uma pré-avaliação sem precisar sair de casa!
  • Family Strategy: programa destinados à profissionais gestantes e futuros papais que terão todo apoio possível neste momento tão especial
  • Wellhub (Gympass) para colocar os exercícios físicos em dia
  • Dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário, para celebrar uma das pessoas mais importantes de sua vida
  • Canal de apoio psicológico e Serviço Social

(Mais) Benefícios

  • Assistência médica e odontológica! Para que você faça check-ups e cuide de você, em primeiro lugar*
  • Participação nos lucros. Afinal, sem os nossos talentos, não poderíamos crescer exponencialmente
  • Auxílio-internet, para apoiar no trabalho em modelo híbrido
  • Seguro de vida
  • Cartão Multibenefícios*

*Você receberá um valor em seu cartão e poderá distribuí-lo entre as opções que melhor se adequam às suas necessidades de acordo com as regras do programa.

Oportunidade de fazer parte de uma cultura inclusiva na Deloitte Brasil

Você pode ser quem realmente é com oportunidade igual de crescimento. Para reforçar esse compromisso, desenvolvemos a estratégia global D&I com os 5 pilares – Origens, Delas, LGBT+, Inclui e Gerações. Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas estão abertas ao público PcD.

Esperamos você neste time!

title: Product Owner - SR
description:
Código da vaga: 56773

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

  • Ei Product Owner - SR), chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

Habilidades Principais:

  • Liderar a squad/projeto ponta a ponta, gerenciando escopo, backlog, prazos, qualidade, orçamento e priorização estratégica, além da gestão de fornecedores.
  • Acompanhar o andamento das frentes de trabalho, resultados esperados vs. obtidos, riscos e indicadores de performance, reportando status e planos de ação aos stakeholders.
  • Atuar na definição e validação de requisitos, escrita de histórias de usuário e construção das jornadas do cliente em parceria com UX, visando a melhor experiência do cliente.
  • Garantir a execução dos projetos conforme a metodologia adotada (PMO ou Ágil), conduzindo cerimônias, acompanhando testes, homologações e implantações.
  • Manter interface constante com tecnologia e áreas parceiras para alinhamentos, priorização do backlog e assegurar entregas conforme o planejado.
  • Monitorar a estabilidade, evolução das entregas e satisfação dos clientes, promovendo melhoria contínua.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência como Product Owner ou liderança de projetos, visão sistêmica do ecossistema bancário e de RH, conhecimento em gestão orçamentária, inglês e/ou espanhol em nível avançado/fluente , e certificações PSPO ou CSPO .

Modelo de Trabalho: Hibrido 3x na semana na região de Santo Amaro - SP.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Especialista de Biometano

title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst (Graduated from 2022-2025)
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.

Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.

Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)

Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: Product Owner
description:
ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Product Owner (PO) for the Revenue Management System (RMS) is responsible for shaping and delivering integrated solutions that support pricing, demand forecasting, and revenue optimization. This role involves managing initiatives that span data engineering, machine learning, and user-facing interfaces. In addition to gathering and managing business requirements, the PO will be responsible for overseeing the full delivery lifecycle to ensure successful execution from concept through release.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop and maintain a backlog of features and enhancements spanning data pipelines, predictive models, and RMS user interfaces.

Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities to optimize pricing strategies and demand forecasting.

Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into detailed epics and user stories with clear descriptions, business rules, and acceptance criteria.

Own the full delivery lifecycle of features and enhancements, ensuring timely execution, alignment with stakeholders, and readiness for deployment.

Collaborate with Data Engineering on requirements for data sourcing, integration, and quality.

Partner with Data Science to define, deploy, and iterate on ML models and pricing algorithms.

Align with UI/UX and front-end teams to ensure a seamless user experience.

Facilitate cross-functional workshops and planning sessions with business stakeholders.

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess product success and user adoption.

Ensure accurate documentation in Confluence and Jira for themes, epics, and tasks.

Coordinate with QA to validate features and ensure delivery meets requirements.

Promote continuous iteration based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.

Drive change management and support user training for new RMS features.

Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and regulatory standards.

Identify and mitigate risks associated with process and system changes.

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.

Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

DEGREE TYPE:

Bachelor's Degree

FIELD(S) OF STUDY:

Business Management, Data Analytics, or related fields

EXPERIENCE;

  • At least 3 years of experience in end-to-end product ownership, product management, or delivery of data or optimization platforms.
  • Experience working across Data Engineering, Data Science, and UI Development teams, as well with multiple stakeholders and brand Revenue Management teams.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments with cross-functional teams.
  • Industry experience in cruise, travel, or enterprise data systems is a plus.

COMPETENCIES/SKILLS

  • Exposure to revenue management, pricing systems, or forecasting tools is preferred
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and iterative development
  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ML model lifecycle, and modern UI patterns
  • Ability to define and refine user stories across technical and business domains
  • Proficient in Jira, Confluence, and backlog management tools
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent facilitation, documentation, and analytical skills
  • Understanding of change management principles and user adoption strategies
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities
  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving capabilities
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, cross-functional environments

CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSES

Add certifications/licenses (if any) here.

  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification preferred
  • Product Management or Lean Six Sigma certification is a plus

ENGLISH RESUMES ONLY

title: Software Engineer, Data
description:
Title: Software Engineer, Data Eng

Level: L2 or L3

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Work setup: Initially remote until we open the office and then Hybrid (2-3 days/week in the office)

Comp: $3800-$4200 USD per month

Company

Talent Systems, LLC is the leading technology solution provider for casting and auditioning to

the entertainment industry. Casting directors and agents worldwide use Talent Systems’

portfolio of products to source and manage talent across film, television, commercials, theater

and digital projects, powering an unparalleled, global casting software ecosystem.

We are headquartered in Los Angeles and operate in the US, Canada, UK, Australia and India.

Our portfolio brands include Casting Networks, Spotlight, Cast It Systems, Cast It Talent,

Casting Frontier, Staff Me Up, Cast It Reach & Tagmin.

Job Description

We are seeking a Software Engineer, Data Engineering to join our Data Engineering team,

where you will play a key role in building and scaling the data platforms, AI/ML infrastructure,

and storage systems that power analytics, BI, and AI/ML initiatives across the company.

Working under the guidance of the Head of Data Engineering, you’ll design and implement

robust pipelines, improve data infrastructure, and collaborate closely with business and

technical stakeholders.

This role is ideal for an engineer who is passionate about solving complex data problems in

advancing our capabilities in BI and AI and other related technologies.

Data Engineering & Development

○ Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to support analytics, BI,

and operational use cases.

○ Contribute to the architecture and development of our data lake and data

warehouse platforms using Snowflake.

○ Optimize workflows for data ingestion, transformation, and storage in cloud

environments in AWS.

○ Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and observability tools.

Collaboration & Delivery

○ Work closely with data analysts, BI developers, and data scientists to understand

requirements and deliver trusted datasets.

○ Partner with software engineering teams to integrate data flows into core

products and services.

○ Participate in Agile ceremonies and ensure high-quality, timely delivery of data

features.

Innovation & Growth

○ Stay current with modern data engineering practices, tools, and technologies.

○ Contribute ideas for improving data platform performance, scalability, and cost

efficiency.

○ Take initiative in troubleshooting, debugging, and optimizing existing pipelines.

Required

○ 3+ (L2) or 5+ (L3) years of professional software engineering or data engineering

experience.

○ Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data processing.

○ Advanced SQL skills and experience with relational databases.

○ Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake (preferred),

BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks.

○ Familiarity with ETL/ELT frameworks and workflow orchestration (Airflow, dbt,

Luigi, Dagster).

○ Understanding of data modeling (dimensional modeling, star/snowflake

schemas).

Preferred

○ Exposure to streaming technologies (Kafka, Kinesis, Flink, Spark Structured

Streaming).

○ Knowledge of data governance, lineage, and cataloging practices.

○ Experience with containerization and DevOps (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).

Soft skills:

○ Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively

in cross-functional teams from different cultures and geolocations.

○ Strong sense of urgency and ability to deliver results in a fast-paced

environment.

○ Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality.

○ Excellent problem-solving skills and a customer-first mindset.

○ Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively

in cross-functional teams from different cultures and geolocations.

title: Estagiário em Remuneração e Budget
description:
CONHEÇA UM POUCO SOBRE O GROUPE SEB:

Facilitar o dia a dia das pessoas, tornando o cotidiano mais agradável ao redor do mundo. É com esse foco que nós do Groupe SEB transformamos há mais de 160 anos as necessidades de nossos consumidores em soluções úteis e inovadoras.

Somos uma empresa Francesa e líder mundial em equipamentos domésticos de pequeno porte. Presente em 150 países com quase 30 marcas no nosso portfólio global, atualmente o grupo possui 492 patentes de produtos ao redor do mundo. No Brasil, destacamos principalmente Arno e Rochedo.

Com 41 unidades industriais, incluindo 2 no Brasil e 11 na França, temos 350 milhões de produtos vendidos por ano sendo 12 produtos vendidos no mundo a cada segundo.

Somos um time de mais de 33 mil colaboradores que perseguem o mesmo compromisso com o desenvolvimento sustentável e valores corporativos: Paixão pela Inovação, Empreendedorismo, Espírito de Equipe, Profissionalismo e Respeito pelas Pessoas.

Sua missão:

A posição de Estagiário de Remuneração, Budget, Mobilidade Global e People Analytics desempenha um papel multifacetado na área de Recursos Humanos de uma organização, fornecendo suporte vital para atividades relacionadas à gestão dessas áreas . Este papel é crucial para garantir a equidade salarial, o controle de despesas, o planejamento financeiro e a facilitação de processos de mobilidade global da empresa, além de transformar dados em informações relevantes para tomada de decisão.

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Suporte na Análise de Remuneração: Auxiliar na coleta e análise de dados relacionados à remuneração dos colaboradores, incluindo aqueles em mobilidade global. Isso envolve a revisão de informações sobre salários, benefícios e políticas de expatriação, garantindo a equidade salarial e a conformidade com regulamentos locais e internacionais.
  • Participação em Pesquisas Salariais: Contribuir para a realização de pesquisas salariais, incluindo aquelas específicas para colaboradores em mobilidade global. Analisar tendências do mercado e fazer recomendações sobre ajustes na estrutura de remuneração.
  • Assistência na Elaboração do Orçamento de Pessoal: Apoiar a equipe na preparação e manutenção do orçamento de pessoal da empresa.
  • Colaboração no Processo de Planejamento Financeiro: Auxiliar na elaboração de relatórios e análises financeiras relacionadas aos custos de pessoal, incluindo aqueles relacionados à mobilidade global.
  • Gestão da Mobilidade Global: Prestar suporte administrativo e operacional para processos de mobilidade global, incluindo a coordenação de vistos, autorizações de trabalho, realocação, alojamento e benefícios para expatriados.
  • Manutenção de Dados e Documentação: Garantir a precisão e a integridade dos dados relacionados à remuneração, orçamento e mobilidade global, mantendo registros atualizados e precisos. Isso inclui a criação e manutenção de documentação relevante, como políticas de remuneração, procedimentos de orçamento e diretrizes de mobilidade.
  • Suporte Administrativo Geral: Prestar assistência administrativa geral à equipe de Recursos Humanos, conforme necessário, ajudando em tarefas como organização de arquivos, agendamento de reuniões e comunicação com colaboradores.

O que você precisa ter para fazer parte desse time:

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor

Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

This is not an academic or purely advisory role . It combines strategy, design, and execution , with a strong bias toward outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and define the Data Services practice model , including service offerings, delivery frameworks, and go-to-market approach
  • Build practical frameworks and accelerators for:
  • Data architecture
  • Data governance
  • Data readiness
  • Data quality and reliability
  • Partner closely with AI and engineering leaders to ensure data underpins all AI and digital engagements
  • Support pre-sales and early client engagements with high-impact advisory and solution design
  • Advise on hiring profiles, team structure, and future evolution of the data practice
  • Help transition the organization from reliance on external partners to a self-sustaining internal data capability

Non-Negotiable Requirements

  • Previous experience working for a consulting organization (mid-size or global)
  • Proven experience building or scaling a data practice, service offering, or consulting capability
  • 10+ years of experience leading or delivering data engineering, data architecture, analytics, or governance initiatives
  • Ability to operate both strategically and hands-on
  • Strong executive-level communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex data concepts
  • Fluent English and comfort working with stakeholders aligned to US Central Time

What You Bring

  • Deep understanding of modern data platforms and how they enable AI/ML and advanced analytics
  • Strong consulting mindset with experience creating reusable frameworks, accelerators, or IP
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, build-from-scratch environments
  • A pragmatic, delivery-focused approach— outcomes over theory
  • Ability to work independently and own the evolution of a practice

Note: There is no fixed technology stack. Tooling will be defined as the practice is built.

Why This Opportunity

  • Foundational role with high influence and visibility
  • Opportunity to design and shape a data practice from day one
  • Work with senior AI, engineering, and executive leadership
  • Full autonomy and flexibility—trusted consultant model
  • Long-term growth potential as the practice scales

title: Analista de Projetos Agile - Projetos de Software
description:
Você curte organizar, tirar impedimentos do caminho e transformar status confusos em relatórios claros e bonitos? Aqui você vai orquestrar entregas com nossos clientes, garantir visibilidade do progresso e manter tudo rodando redondinho no Jira.

Propósito da Vaga:

Gerenciar o ciclo de vida dos projetos dos clientes Timeware — do planejamento à entrega — garantindo controle de atividades, evolução por frentes, comunicação executiva (status report/newsletter) e relacionamento contínuo no pós-venda (perfil farmer ), atuando como ponte entre stakeholders e times técnicos.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Conduzir a rotina de delivery : planejar sprints, acompanhar execução, remover impedimentos e gerir dependências.
  • Manter o Jira vivo : boards, epics, stories, burndown, dashboards e relatórios padronizados por cliente.

  • Newsletter de projetos para stakeholders: highlights, marcos, releases e métricas de saúde.
  • Gerenciamento de roadmap e releases (em parceria com Produto/Tech Leads).

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (planning, daily, review, retro, refinement) e adotar boas práticas de fluxo (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Acompanhar OKRs / KPIs de delivery (lead time, throughput, previsibilidade, SLA, NPS).

Atividades do dia a dia:

  • Atualizar boards, prioridades e dependências no Jira.
  • Preparar dashboards e relatórios (Jira/Excel/PowerPoint).
  • Rodar dailies/semanais com o time e checkpoint executivo com o cliente.

  • Visitar clientes (agenda combinada) para health-check e alinhamento de expectativas.

  • Métodos : Scrum, Kanban, Lean, Lean Inception , Design Thinking, PMBOK/PMI, ITIL (gestão de mudanças e incidentes).
  • Ferramentas : Jira (obrigatório), Confluence, Microsoft Project, PowerPoint (avançado), Excel (tabelas dinâmicas / gráficos),

  • Gestão por métricas : lead/cycle time, CFD, burndown/burnup, throughput, previsibilidade, capacidade.

Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills):

  • Negociação e alinhamento de expectativas com múltiplos stakeholders.

Diferenciais:

title: Analista de P&D Analítico Pleno
description:
Atividades:

  • Pesquisar, desenvolver e validar métodos analíticos de identificação, doseamento, dissolução, impurezas e/ou resíduos para matérias-primas e produtos acabados, empregando técnicas como espectrofotometria (UV-VIS), cromatografia líquida de alta eficiência (HPLC), cromatografia gasosa (CG) e absorção atômica (AA).
  • Assegurar a adequabilidade das metodologias farmacopeicas de matérias primas e produtos acabados para garantir a sua reprodutibilidade nas condições do laboratório.
  • Realizar as análises necessárias para dar o suporte analítico para as áreas de interface, durante o desenvolvimento de produto.
  • Realizar a análise crítica dos resultados das análises realizadas durante o desenvolvimento de produto (sejam elas internas ou externas), de forma a garantir a confiabilidade dos resultados.
  • Elaborar a documentação necessária aos processos de registros, renovação de registros ou alterações pós-registro, bem como o cumprimento de exigências.
  • Realizar a transferência de metodologias analíticas, garantindo a correta execução do procedimento analítico.
  • Realizar a análise crítica dos indicadores do setor visando garantir as entregas dentro dos prazos estipulados.
  • Elaborar e realizar treinamentos dos procedimentos operacionais relacionados ao processo de desenvolvimento analítico, garantindo a disseminação das informações e padronizando as atividades, bem como de conhecimentos adquiridos em projetos, replicação de treinamentos externos e normas e legislações que impactam nas rotinas de trabalho.
  • Participar do processo de qualificações dos equipamentos da área, para garantir a confiabilidade dos resultados gerados.
  • Realizar o levantamento, orçamento e requisição de compra de materiais e equipamentos necessários para o desenvolvimento das atividades.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior: Química, Farmácia, ou áreas afins.
  • LÍNGUA INGLESA - Conhecimento básico em língua inglesa.
  • BPF (Boas Práticas de Fabricação) - Garantir o cumprimento das BPF.
  • BPL (BOAS PRÁTICAS DE LABORATÓRIO) - Cumprir com as BPL.
  • Domínio das técnicas instrumentais, tais como HPLC, GC, FTIR, espectrofotometria UV etc.
  • Domínio das análises físico-químicas tais como titulação, CCD, gravimetria, desintegração, friabilidade, dureza, polarimetria etc.
  • Utilizar o gerenciador eletrônico nos processos de elaboração e revisão de documentos.
  • Capacidade para redigir documentação técnica de forma clara, objetiva e respeitando as regras da língua portuguesa.
  • Capacidade de elaborar e executar planos, definindo metodologias e recursos, distribuindo prazos e tarefas e estabelecendo prioridades, metas e indicadores. Acompanhar a execução das etapas, propondo redirecionamentos e avaliando resultados de acordo com os cenários.

Horário: 7:30 as 17:30 de Segunda a Quinta-feira e na sexta-feira, 7:30 as 16:15 .

title: Facilities Manager
description:
MISSION

Lead and oversee all Facilities operations across Corporate Offices, R&D Labs, Manufacturing Plant, and Distribution Center, ensuring safe, efficient, compliant, and cost-effective infrastructure. Drive operational excellence through strong vendor management, robust maintenance programs, and continuous improvement. Act as the key connection between local operations and global standards for EHS, Engineering, and Sustainability.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensure a safe work environment by promoting a strong safety culture and full compliance with legal requirements, NRs, company HSE policies, and global corporate standards.
  • Guarantee the integrity, reliability, and availability of all facilities infrastructure, including utilities, HVAC, electrical systems, water treatment, fire protection, building automation, and critical assets.
  • Lead, develop, and oversee internal and outsourced teams (maintenance, cleaning, security, reception, gardening, cafeteria, and services).
  • Manage preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance programs, ensuring uptime and operational continuity for Office, R&D Labs, Manufacturing, and Distribution Center.
  • Oversee facilities services to ensure high service levels, cost efficiency, and adherence to SLAs.
  • Lead improvement initiatives to enhance energy efficiency, sustainability, waste reduction, and operational performance.
  • Ensure compliance with certifications, internal audits, external audits, and global standards (ISO, GMP where applicable).
  • Oversee space planning, workplace strategy, building layout updates, and occupancy optimization.
  • Manage construction projects, renovations, expansions, and infrastructure modifications from planning to delivery, ensuring alignment with Capex governance.
  • Coordinate incident management, emergency response plans, fire brigade activities, and building security protocols.
  • Monitor and manage facilities KPIs, identifying root causes and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage Opex and Capex budgets, ensuring cost optimization and adherence to financial targets.
  • Collaborate with key internal stakeholders (Manufacturing, R&D, Supply Chain, HR, IT, Security, Finance) to ensure seamless and compliant operations.
  • Ensure vendor management excellence, including contract negotiation, performance monitoring, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for facilities matters with local leadership and global functional teams.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical), Architecture, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Experience managing Facilities operations across multi-site or complex environments (Office, Industrial, Logistics, or R&D).
  • Minimum of 5 years of proven leadership experience in maintenance, utilities, infrastructure, or facilities services.
  • Strong technical background in building systems (HVAC, electrical, utilities, fire systems).
  • Demonstrated experience in maintenance management, vendor management, and project leadership.
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements (NRs), engineering standards, and EHS.
  • Proven experience in managing Capex and Opex budgets.
  • Experience in multinational environments is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

SOFT SKILLS

  • Ownership mindset, with strong presence in operations and a hands-on approach.
  • High level of discipline, organization, and operational rigor.
  • Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning mindset.
  • Agile, creative, and solution-oriented profile.
  • Strong critical thinking and ability to anticipate risks.
  • Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams with engagement and accountability.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Resilience and ability to deliver impactful results under pressure.

title: Viral video content creator
description:
Looking for a Viral Video Scriptwriter + Editor who can consistently create viral-style performance video ads using AI tools at scale. You will own the output like it’s your channel, not a “tasks” role.

We run performance marketing campaigns and need a steady pipeline of fresh, high-converting video creatives for the US consumer.

Mission for this job

Own the end-to-end creative pipeline for short-form video ads:

  • Research the market and audience
  • Write scripts that hook hard and hold attention
  • Edit fast, clean videos using AI + simple editing tools
  • Ship volume, learn from results, and iterate daily
What success looks likeFirst 30 days
  • Learn our offers, compliance guardrails, and what “good” looks like for us.
  • Deliver a consistent daily output of scripts + edited videos (with clear naming and organization).
  • Build a repeatable workflow using AI tools for speed (script, voice, visuals, editing, captions).
  • Show you can research the US consumer and write in natural, native-sounding English.
By 90 days
  • Ship a reliable volume of creatives every week with clear variation by hook, angle, and structure.
  • Consistently produce multiple “winners” per month (videos we can scale spend behind).
  • Maintain a simple testing system: what you tried, what worked, what failed, and what to do next.
  • Become independent: you don’t wait for perfect direction to move.
By 12 months
  • Fully own a creative machine that feeds our ad accounts nonstop.
  • Have a documented system another creator could follow.
  • Be the go-to person for viral ad formats, hooks, and creative strategy across offers.
What you will do
  • Write short-form ad scripts (UGC style, narration, simple scenes, strong hooks).
  • Do research (audience pains, language, objections, comments, competitor ads).
  • Edit videos in CapCut (or similar) and ship finished assets ready to launch.
  • Use AI tools to generate footage, b-roll, voice, captions, and variations fast.
  • Create lots of iterations: new hooks, new openings, new pacing, new visuals.
  • Organize deliverables cleanly (folders, versions, naming, notes).
Who you are
  • You have a portfolio of viral videos, ad creatives, or short-form edits.
  • You have strong English and can write like a real US consumer talks.
  • You understand basic copywriting: hook, problem, proof, offer, CTA.
  • You can edit quickly in CapCut (or similar) and keep pacing tight.
  • You’ve used AI tools to create videos at scale (not just one-offs).
  • You move fast, learn fast, and you care more about output and results than comfort.
Core values

Resourcefulness – You figure things out with minimal help.

Perfectly acceptable over perfection – Ship fast, then improve.

Constructive disagreement – Challenge ideas to get to the truth.

Kind, not nice – Honest feedback that helps people win long term.

Growth mindset – Learn from misses, don’t repeat mistakes.

Full ownership – Act like the outcome is on you.

Offer

Competitive pay + profit share based on skill and output, with clear growth as you produce consistent winners.

Apply

Email

with:

  • Your portfolio (required if you have it)
  • A short note on your AI + editing workflow
  • 2–3 examples you’re most proud of and why they worked

If you don’t have a portfolio but you’re sure you can win in this role, email anyway and explain your background plus how you’ll prove yourself fast.

title: Agile Coach Senior
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Agile Coach Senior , who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

Principais Responsabilidades

  • 1) Kanban – Upstream (Discovery)
  • Estruturar o Kanban upstream para triagem, qualificação e priorização de demanda (intake/triage, option pool, readiness policies).
  • Implementar políticas de entrada (Definition of Ready) e critérios de seleção baseados em capacidade e impacto.
  • Facilitar Upstream Kanban cadences: Replenishment, Strategy Review, Risk Review.
  • Construir classes de serviço, limites de WIP e SLAs de discovery; conectar upstream ao portfólio/OKRs.
  • 2) Kanban – Downstream (Delivery)
  • Modelar fluxos de entrega com estados claros (e.g., design → build → review → deploy → done).
  • Definir WIP, Classes de Serviço (e.g., Expedite, Fixed Date, Standard, Intangible) e Policies explícitas.
  • Medir e melhorar Lead Time, Cycle Time, Throughput, Flow Efficiency e CFD (Cumulative Flow Diagram).
  • Promover cadências: Daily Flow Review, Service Delivery Review, Operations Review e Retrospectivas orientadas a dados.
  • 3) Coaching Multinível (Chapter, Squad, Tribe, Guild)
  • Squads: coaching hands-on; facilitação de cerimônias; remoção de impedimentos sistêmicos; melhoria do fluxo.
  • Chapters: padronização de práticas, políticas e dashboards; trilhas de capacitação; comunidades de prática.
  • Tribes: governança de portfólio com Kanban Flight Levels; gestão de dependências; alinhamento com OKRs.
  • Guilds: curadoria de conteúdo; fóruns de aprendizagem; benchmarks; roadmap de maturidade.
  • 4) Jira – Expert
  • Desenhar e manter Workflows Kanban (estados, transições, validators, conditions, post-functions).
  • Configurar Boards, Swimlanes, Quick Filters, WIP Limits, Card Colors e Automation Rules.
  • Implantar dashboards executivos e operacionais: CFD, Control Chart, Lead Time percentis, Aging WIP, Throughput trends.
  • Governar schemas de issue types, fields (custom), screens, permissions, versioning e integrações (Jira Align/Portfolio, Confluence, Bitbucket, DevOps).
  • Garantir data quality e taxonomias (componentes, labels, epics, initiatives).
  • 5) Métricas, Análise e Melhoria Contínua
  • Construir e monitorar Service Level Expectations (SLEs) com percentis (e.g., P50/P85/P95).
  • Rodar análises de variabilidade, aging work-in-progress e flow debt; conduzir ações de redução.
  • Conectar métricas de fluxo a outcomes de negócio (NPS, adoção, churn, tempo de resposta, satisfação interna).
  • Reportar em ritmos executivos: Health Check por Tribe, trend de previsibilidade, capacidade x demanda.
  • 6) Change Management & Cultura
  • Conduzir jornadas de adoção (mapa de stakeholders, comunicação, treinamento, coaching 1:1).
  • Estabelecer políticas explícitas e acordos de serviço (SLA/SLE, políticas de bloqueio, políticas de revisão).
  • Promover experimentos de melhoria (kaizens) e A3 problem solving.

Mandatory skills:

  • Domínio de Kanban (upstream e downstream) com aplicação prática comprovada em múltiplos times.
  • Experiência atuando em Chapter, Squad, Tribe e Guild (estrutura de Agile at Scale).
  • Jira avançado: workflows, automations, dashboards, control chart, CFD, governance e integrações.
  • Métricas de fluxo: Lead/Cycle Time, Throughput, WIP, CFD, Flow Efficiency, Aging WIP, percentis e SLEs.
  • Facilitação de cadências Kanban e práticas de Service Delivery.
  • Experiência com gestão de dependências e portfólio em ambientes multi-equipes.
  • Habilidade de coaching, comunicação, influência e formação de comunidades.
  • Português fluente; leitura técnica em inglês.

Desirable Skills:

  • Certificações: AKC/AKP/KMP (Kanban University), PSK (Scrum.org), SAFe/Kanban Flight Levels.
  • Experiência com Jira Align, Confluence, Bitbucket/GitHub, Azure DevOps.
  • Background em Data & AI / Produto Digital B2C/B2B, e analytics orientado a valor.
  • Vivência com OKRs, product discovery, service design, SRE/DevOps.
  • Conhecimento em Lean, Theory of Constraints, Cost of Delay e Classes de Serviço avançadas.

title: Business Analyst
description:
THE ROLE

Love building things fast and figuring out what works? Curious about AI and excited to push the boundaries of what's possible? We're looking for a Business Analyst to join our Strategy team. You'll be our rapid prototyper---turning ideas into working features, testing what resonates, and handing off polished concepts to engineering for the full build. It's part builder, part thinker, and a whole lot of experimentation.

You'll work directly with the VP of Strategy and collaborate across product, engineering, and AI teams to bring new features to life quickly. If you're resourceful, creative, and love the thrill of "let's just try it and see," you'll thrive here.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build fully functioning feature prototypes using AI tools like Claude Code and our platform
  • Test, iterate, and refine ideas with real users before they hit full production
  • Work backwards from customer problems to design solutions that actually solve them
  • Collaborate with engineers to hand off working prototypes for implementation
  • Stay curious about AI capabilities and explore creative ways to leverage them

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • A knack for figuring things out---you don't need to know code, but you're not afraid to tinker
  • Strong product intuition and a bias toward action over perfection
  • Experience building, prototyping, or problem-solving in scrappy environments
  • Excellent communication skills---you can explain what you built and why it matters
  • Genuine interest in AI and emerging tools (exposure is a plus, enthusiasm is a must)
  • Bonus points for finance experience, but not required
  • Bonus points if you've worked with automation tools, no-code platforms, or AI assistants

Why Street Diligence?

We're The Deal Nerds making sense of complex contracts so our clients don't have to. But we're also builders who believe the best way to know if something works is to build it and test it. We move fast, we experiment often, and we're not afraid to try the unconventional approach. If you love the zero-to-one phase and want to shape how AI transforms financial intelligence, come join the crew.

title: Assessor de Investimentos Experiente
description:
Você quer trabalhar em uma Corretora de Valores com plano de carreira bem definido e personalizado, que dê a você todo o suporte necessário para alavancar sua carreira, com regras claras para seu bônus e uma trilha real de crescimento?

Na EQI Investimentos, você encontra uma Corretora focada no atendimento de clientes “Private”, onde seu trabalho é valorizado: remuneração é competitiva, autonomia para negociar, plano de crescimento estruturado, liderança próxima, suporte integral, tecnologia e oportunidades para evoluir na carreira de “Wealth Management” ou empreender para ter seu escritório B2B. Aqui você tem oportunidades sob medida para umas verdadeiras evoluções na sua carreira.

Na EQI, sabemos que seus sonhos são únicos, reconhecemos suas conquistas e oferecemos estrutura real para você ir além.

Candidate-se agora e transforme seu futuro.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Prospectar, desenvolver e fechar negócios com investidores de alta renda em todo o Brasil;
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com clientes através de visitas e contatos recorrentes;

  • Formação cursando ou completa, preferencialmente em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;

  • Experiência prévia no mercado financeiro;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, além de perfil colaborativo, com alta capacidade de influência e construção de relacionamentos;

O que oferecemos

  • Plano de carreira estruturado e diferenciado .

Benefícios

  • VA/VR de R$ 1.812

title: Analista de Operações e Controle
description:
Seja bem-vindo(a) à página do Sicoob Engecred!

Há 25 anos no mercado financeiro, o Sicoob Engecred figura entre as maiores cooperativas do Sistema Sicoob, com R$ 4,2 bilhões em ativos totais e cerca de 25 mil cooperados em todas as regiões do país, por meio da associação digital.

Temos em nosso DNA o interesse genuíno pelas pessoas, seja dentro da cooperativa – o que nos levou a conquistar 19 premiações em rankings regionais e nacionais do Great Place to Work (GPTW) -, ou junto aos nossos associados, oferecendo soluções financeiras adequadas e com taxas justas. Isto sem falar nos benefícios que geramos nas comunidades onde atuamos, fomentando negócios e promovendo diversas ações sociais por meio do Instituto Sicoob.

Classificada como A+(bra) pela Fitch Ratings, a instituição tem seus números auditados pela Deloitte. Em 2024, se tornou a primeira cooperativa do Sistema Sicoob, em Goiás, a conquistar a Categoria Plena pelo Banco Central e, também, a obter o selo Empresa Limpa, feitos que reforçam sua credibilidade e postura ética.

Com sede em Goiânia (GO), atualmente possui agências físicas em Goiás e Minas Gerais, além de escritórios de negócios em Betim (MG), Juiz de Fora (MG), Brasília (DF), Campo Grande (MS), Campinas (SP) e São Paulo (SP).

Seguimos em busca de soluções e experiências inovadoras e sustentáveis para, por meio da cooperação, viabilizar o desenvolvimento econômico e social de comunidades.

Junte-se a nós, faça parte desta jornada de sucesso!

Analista de Estratégia Financeira

Requisitos:

  • Experiência prévia em backoffice financeiro , operações estruturadas, asset , banco, securitizadora, DTVM ou administrador fiduciário;
  • Vivência prática com CRA, CRI, FIDC e/ou FII , especialmente em: controle de lastros, acompanhamento de emissões, monitoramento pós-emissão;
  • Experiência com conciliações financeiras e documentais ;
  • Familiaridade com rotinas de auditoria, compliance operacional e governança ;
  • Excel em nível intermediário (controles, conciliações, organização e rastreabilidade de dados);
  • Certificação CEA.

Atividades:

  • Realizar o controle, acompanhamento e validação de lastros relacionados a LCA, LCI, CRA, CRI, FIDC e FII , bem como instrumentos associados (CCIs, recebíveis e contratos);
  • Garantir a rastreabilidade ponta a ponta dos ativos , desde a originação até a liquidação e o acompanhamento pós-emissão;
  • Executar conciliações financeiras, contábeis e documentais dos produtos estruturados;
  • Manter e atualizar checklists operacionais e regulatórios por tipo de produto (CRA, CRI, FIDC e FII);
  • Organizar, validar e custodiar a documentação necessária para auditorias internas, externas e regulatórias ;
  • Atuar como ponto focal operacional junto a: administradores fiduciários, custodiante, auditoria, jurídico, áreas internas;
  • Apoiar os processos de emissão, acompanhamento e monitoramento de CRA, CRI e FIDC , assegurando aderência aos critérios e aprovações vigentes;
  • Apoiar o acompanhamento operacional e documental de ativos e fundos imobiliários (FII) , quando aplicável;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento, padronização e melhoria contínua de processos (POPs) e controles da Tesouraria;
  • Identificar, reportar e mitigar riscos operacionais e de lastro , propondo melhorias estruturais de controle .

Benefícios: vale-alimentação/refeição de R$ 2.022,85, vale-transporte, plano de saúde Unimed, plano odontológico Uniodonto, auxílio-creche/babá, bolsa de estudos, seguro de vida, Gympass, Zenklub, previdência privada, adicional por tempo de casa, participação nos resultados e plano de carreira.

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas - Máquina de cartão - Mercado Pago - RS
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.

Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.

Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.

Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
  • Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
  • Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
  • Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.

Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
  • Possuir CNH "B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
  • Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de atuação.

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Global Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as University of São Paulo, UNICAMP and UNESP. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

The Role

We are seeking a proactive, results-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our global HR team. In this role, you will drive the hiring of top-tier talent across Europe and APAC, and help us build high-performing teams in both technical and business functions. You will own the end-to-end recruitment process, build and nurture strong talent pipelines, and deliver a fast, high-quality hiring experience that directly contributes to our company’s growth and success worldwide.

Responsibilities:

  • Execute targeted hiring strategies to identify, and hire high-quality talent across sales, technical, and business roles.
  • Proactively source candidates using diverse channels, including job boards, social media, professional networks, referrals, and direct outreach.
  • Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline to support rapid hiring and future growth.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements, skill needs, and success profiles.
  • Track and report key recruiting metrics (time-to-hire, pipeline quality, candidate conversion rates) to support continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a brand ambassador, ensuring candidates clearly understand the company’s mission, values, and employee experience.
  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle—sourcing, screening, interviewing, coordinating assessments, and facilitating selection decisions.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date candidate data in the applicant tracking system (ATS).

Requirements :

  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in talent acquisition, preferably in software or technology companies.
  • Fluent English communication skills.
  • Experience supporting global recruitment, ideally across Europe and APAC.
  • Proficiency with recruiting and sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, and other platforms.
  • Ability to adapt quickly, work independently, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ambitious, results-driven, and thrives in high-growth settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and candidate experience skills.

Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation package competitively placed within the local market
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team

We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.

Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.

Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.

Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.g., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.

Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role; experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

title: Data Engineer
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Now part of the global portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader.
